pairs.human_note:
According to the neural latents benchmark (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2109.04463) in Table 4, the MC_Maze datasets have the following unit counts:
- MC_Maze: 137 held-in, 45 held out = 182 total
- MC_Maze-S 107 held in, 35 held out = 142 total
- MC_Maze-M 114 held in, 38 held out = 152 total
- MC_Maze-L 122 held in, 40 held out = 162 total
In this paper, the unit counts are listed in Table 1: N_in = 137, N_out = 45, matching MC_Maze exactly. Thus, the dandiset they reused was 000128.
